correctness.rationale: The degree-three Chebyshev solution polynomial is expanded exactly. Its diagonal entries are positive because the scalar polynomial is positive on the spectral interval. For off-diagonal entries of a Stieltjes matrix, the \(A^2\) term splits into a direct-edge contribution and nonnegative two-edge path products; the direct coefficient is nonnegative exactly under the universal estimate \(L\le3\mu\). Two dimensions admit the stronger trace identity, while the explicit three-dimensional block family makes the same direct coefficient negative for every \(\kappa>3\). Exact replay verifies the formulas.

value.rationale: Chebyshev semi-iteration is a classical low-communication accelerator, and Stieltjes systems have nonnegative exact solutions in many discretization settings. A negative accelerated coordinate is therefore a meaningful structural failure. The theorem gives a sharp conditioning threshold, proves complete low-dimensional immunity, and provides an exact minimal-dimensional witness, making the result useful for method selection and regression testing.
